title: adhatoda adhatoda
intro: Adhatoda adhatoda, commonly known as Vasa or Malabar nut, is a plant species native to India and Sri Lanka, belonging to the family Acanthaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for centuries to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The health benefits of Adhatoda adhatoda include reducing inflammation, relieving cough and congestion, and supporting cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include rosmarinic acid, adhatodine, and adhatodol, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
